title: Share attention, not dashboards
summary: Contextual collaboration on AI-generated UI: a focus handoff carries what the sender wanted looked at, not just the link. The design, why it is deliberately not a commenting system, and what checking it against Loom and loom-ui corrected.

title: Your Agent's Answer Deserves a Picture. It Shouldn't Have to Draw One.
summary: Agents do an analyst's work and then flatten it into paragraphs. An experience runtime treats the visual as a projection of the execution record: built from evidence, silent by default, rendered per surface, and turned into the next question. Plus how to build it on Loom and loom-ui.

title: State is a fold, not a blob
summary: Why Loom records every step as an immutable event and derives state from the log — and what that buys you when a workflow has to survive a crash, a redeploy, or a human taking three days to approve.
